source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare = {v for v, n in counts.items() if v != background and n < h * w * 0.1}
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in rare]
    rows = sorted({r for r, c in points})
    cols = sorted({c for r, c in points})
    # Marker points lie on a regular lattice; use the rare-color bounding lattice.
    vals = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    out = [[background for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for r in range(len(rows)-1):
        for c in range(len(cols)-1):
            block = [vals[r][c], vals[r][c+1], vals[r+1][c], vals[r+1][c+1]]
            if block[0] in rare and all(v == block[0] for v in block):
                out[r][c] = block[0]
    return out
'''

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    rare = {v for v, n in counts.items() if n < h * w * 0.1}
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] in rare]
    rows = sorted({r for r, c in points})
    cols = sorted({c for r, c in points})
    vals = [[grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
    line_color = Counter(v for row in vals for v in row if v not in rare).most_common(1)[0][0]
    background = Counter({v: n for v, n in counts.items() if v not in rare and v != line_color}).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for r in range(len(rows)-1):

            if block[0] in rare and all(v == block[0] for v in block):

    return out
'''
